summary: Appeal against High Court's conviction in murder case after Trial Court acquittal; three appellants (A3-A5) convicted by HC for stabbing/deadly assault causing death from hemorrhage shock; inconsistencies in witness accounts regarding timing of incident; panch witnesses corroborated seizure of weapons; discovery trails validated evidence recovery; Trial Court's acquittal based on benefit of doubt overturned by HC and affirmed by SC; co-accused acquitted due to lack of specific evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court conviction upheld; life imprisonment confirmed for appellants.
